_meta.generated_semantics: Registered contract-effective time for a deterministic refusal artifact.
_meta.partial_definition: This endpoint emits no provider-derived values while any required signed rights decision is absent.
_meta.license: CC BY 4.0 for IGRM-authored schema and refusal text only; this endpoint releases no upstream-derived values
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). IGRM Global Event and Episode Ledger rights-gated release status. https://igrm.in/data/event_ledger.json
_meta.what: A fail-closed Global Event and Episode Ledger endpoint. Its blocked form contains no source-derived values; a future authorized form may publish the explicitly bounded aggregate and detector units described by the stable API contract.

boundary.required_human_action: Independent source-terms review and a human-signed decision for every required source; agents may not sign.
boundary.scope_note: This refusal governs event_ledger.json and ledger.html. It neither licenses nor retracts pre-existing source-specific endpoints, whose rights decisions remain separate and pending.
prohibited_interpretations: A count of unique geopolitical events
A world risk, severity or probability score
A claim that missing countries or days have zero events
A like-for-like longitudinal comparison of raw row levels across unregistered provider corpus regimes

aggregate_source_rows.definition: Counts of valid-layout rows in a named GDELT daily export after the published India-involvement filter, plus the valid-layout row denominator. Malformed rows rejected before parsing are not counted. Rows are not deduplicated by stable event identity.

deduplicated_source_events.definition: Distinct upstream events after stable-ID deduplication and revision handling.
deduplicated_source_events.blocked_reason: The current aggregate store does not retain GlobalEventID or raw-row revision lineage.

canonical_geopolitical_events.definition: Cross-source resolved, typed and versioned geopolitical event objects that pass the canonical-release rights, method and signature gates.
canonical_geopolitical_events.blocked_reason: No production canonical event release has been issued; source rights, method and release-signer registries remain fail-closed.

detected_salience_episodes.definition: Threshold-defined windows in the five IGRM press-salience channels. An episode is a detector output, not a unique geopolitical event or an event census.

requirements: Stable source identifiers and raw evidence lineage
Cross-source resolution with declared independence groups
Role-eligible evidence for every lifecycle transition
Registered executable methods or signed manual decisions
Point-in-time revision log and correction blast-radius graph
